tickets.diagnosticInference: Upstream provider authentication token for CT-02 has expired; this is a provider credential lifecycle issue, not an Android TV hardware or GOJJA APK crash.
tickets.suggestedNextAction: Refresh provider secret reference in TV Services → Provider Connection and run TV-side connection probe.
tickets.limitationsNote: Read-only diagnostic assistant. Cannot autonomously modify provider credentials or reset TV.

tickets.diagnosticInference: Room 202 keycard power or local AP connection dropped before checksum verification completed.
tickets.suggestedNextAction: Verify room power/AP in Room 202; endpoint will automatically resume staging and ACK v4 upon reconnect.
tickets.limitationsNote: Read-only diagnostic assistant. Cannot power on physical TV panel remotely when AC power is cut.
